senses.gloss: f. (עָרַךְ; an adapt. of ἀρχή, ἀρχεῖον) recorder’s office for pedigree, deeds of sale &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 4:5">Kidd. IV, 5</cite> <he>בע׳ הישנה</he>, v. <cite ref="A03140"><he>אַרְכִי</he> I</cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="P01379"><he>עַרְכָאוֹת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Gittin 44a:10">Gitt. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>כותב ומעלה בע׳ וכ׳</he> (Ar. <he>בערכין</he>) he writes (a deed of sale) and has it recorded in the office of gentiles (Romans); <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 13a:7">Ab. Zar. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>בע׳ שלהן</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 1:8">Tosef. ib. I, 8</cite> <he>בעַרְכָאִים</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Moed Kattan 2">Tosef. M. Kat. II</cite>, (I), 1 <he>בעַרְכָיִים</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 1:5">Gitt. I, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Gittin 1:4">Tosef. ib. I, 4</cite> <he>שטרות העולים בע׳ וכ׳</he> (Var. <he>בעַרְכָיוֹת</he>) deeds entered in gentile offices.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 8:2">Tosef. B. Bath. VIII, 2</cite> <he>כתב והעלה להם בערכאים זכה להם הערכיים</he> if he wrote (a deed of donation for ten persons) and had it recorded for them in the office, the office took possession in their behalf; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 8:3">ib. 3</cite> <he>עַרְכָאִין … עַרְכָיִין</he>; a. e.
